event.tagline: Engineering the next generation of developer infrastructure

rubric.name: Technical Execution & Architecture
rubric.description: Depth of engineering complexity, code quality, robustness, and architectural soundness.

rubric.name: Originality & Technical Innovation
rubric.description: Novelty of approach, uniqueness of the problem solved, and creative problem solving.

rubric.name: Completeness & Functionality
rubric.description: Degree to which the core technical prototype works, edge cases handled, and demo reliability.

rubric.name: Clarity & Engineering Presentation
rubric.description: Quality of technical documentation, architectural diagrams, and clarity of the demo.

projects.title: KubePulse: Lightweight Distributed Telemetry for Edge Nodes
projects.summary: Real-time telemetry and health monitoring agent optimized for resource-constrained edge computing environments.
projects.description: KubePulse collects, correlates, and aggregates node metrics with less than 15MB memory footprint. Uses eBPF for zero-overhead syscall interception and streaming gRPC back to central collector.

projects.title: AegisDB: Deterministic Time-Travel Database Engine
projects.summary: Embedded transactional database engine supporting point-in-time branch queries and cryptographic audit proofs.
projects.description: AegisDB implements immutable append-only storage with persistent trees to offer microsecond time-travel queries across historical transactions. Features zero-copy snapshots and automatic compaction.

projects.title: SpectraTrace: Autonomous API Vulnerability Fuzzer
projects.summary: Self-adapting grammar-guided fuzzer targeting GraphQL and OpenAPI service endpoints.
projects.description: SpectraTrace combines static schema analysis with dynamic feedback loops to detect race conditions, IDOR weaknesses, and broken object level authorization across microservice ecosystems.

projects.title: VoxelFlow: Streaming 3D Gaussian Splatting Renderer
projects.summary: WebGPU-based client-side progressive volumetric reconstruction engine for web browsers.
projects.description: VoxelFlow streams hierarchical scene partitions using octrees and evaluates 3D Gaussian radiance fields directly in compute shaders at 60 FPS without external native plugins.

projects.title: ByteBridge: Zero-Copy IPC Transport for Heterogeneous Subsystems
projects.summary: Ultra-low latency shared-memory transport mechanism for polyglot micro-kernels.
projects.description: Provides lockless ring buffers with cache-aligned message headers enabling sub-microsecond roundtrip IPC across Rust, Go, and C++ processes running on Linux and Darwin.

projects.title: CodeSentinel: Static Concurrency Deadlock Detector
projects.summary: Symbolic execution tool specifically detecting channel leaks and deadlock cycles in asynchronous applications.
projects.description: CodeSentinel builds abstract interpretation control-flow graphs to pinpoint thread contention and lock ordering violations prior to deployment.
